structure: Montana Content Standards for Social Studies (2021), Excel workbook rendered as units [R# rows], one standard per row. Sheets: Intro (adoption notes), K-12 Complete (New Rules I-IX in one sheet: Rule I = content areas and skills; II=K, III=Grade 1, IV=Grade 2, V=Grade 3, VI=Grade 4, VII=Grade 5, VIII=Grades 6-8, IX=Grades 9-12), K-12 Content and Skills (Rule I only), then one sheet per grade band (Kindergarten, First Grade, Second Grade, Third Grade, Fourth Grade, Fifth Grade, 6-8 Grades, 9-12 Grades). Within each grade: four numbered content areas (1) civics and government, (2) economics, (3) geography, (4) history, each a lead-in row followed by lettered standards (a), (b)... Rule headings give the grade. No separate examples or teacher notes.
